VERDICT: LGTM

The notification is placed in exactly the right spot — inside the existing `if (isNew)` create-success block, right alongside the `AUDIT` side-effects it logically belongs with. It mirrors the established `AUDIT` logger convention precisely: a `static final Logger NOTIFY` field with a parallel Javadoc comment, and an `info(...)` call using the same parameterized-message style as the adjacent human-readable `AUDIT.info` line. Owner id and memberId are both carried as required. No duplication, no catch-all growth, and a maintainer of this file would find it the natural way to add this behavior.
